name: Open-Set Semantic Fusion via Normal-Inverse-Gamma Conjugacy
definition: A Bayesian method for fusing continuous semantic feature vectors (open-set, e.g., from VLMs) into voxels by modeling each feature element as a Gaussian with unknown mean and variance, using a Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG) conjugate prior.
summary: Open-Set Semantic Fusion via Normal-Inverse-Gamma Conjugacy fuses continuous VLM features into voxels using a conjugate prior to model uncertainty and represent unseen concepts, unlike closed-set methods.
